mentions.name: Automatic diode curve test equipment
mentions.description: A homemade automatic test equipment setup for electronic component characterization, built with multiple measurement channels. The first two channels have completed calibration, enabling measurement of diode characteristic curves.
mentions.source_excerpt: After 2 months of work I finally finished calibration of first 2 channels of my automatic test equipment and now I can finally measure diode curves.
mentions.author: dvh
